status: candidate preregistration stack only; no validation claimed
polaris: Can I_phi be computed from input-side spectroscopy, structure, and dephasing before bulk superconducting outputs are inspected?
framework: Leakage-controlled input encoder for layered nickelates, using only same-sample normal-state or structure/spectroscopy variables. The physical ingredients are prior art; the only surviving target is a non-circular measurement protocol.
findings: Round 2 reduces I_phi to an executable, lab-feasible measurement stack. The least-circular C_phi is a normal-state c-axis optical transfer-matrix/Drude audit computed at frozen pressure-temperature points and fixed frequency windows, with Josephson plasma, superfluid density, Meissner response, zero resistance, critical current, condensate spectral weight, and bulk phase stiffness explicitly forbidden. E_z2, Gamma_phi, and E_floor can be computed with exact units if all coefficients and windows are frozen before output reveal. This is not validation; it is a preregistered encoder specification plus mock arithmetic.
weakest_link: C_phi remains the weakest link because normal-state c-axis optical decomposition can collapse into a generic interlayer-coherence proxy or leak output information if windows, temperature selection, pressure inclusion, or fit components are chosen after viewing superconducting outcomes.
next_plan: Have INSPECTOR audit whether the C_phi transfer-matrix recipe and missing-data rules fully prevent output leakage; if it passes, PI can assemble a blind preregistration packet for real same-sample data.
literature_needed: same-sample La3Ni2O7 c-axis optical conductivity under pressure before bulk-output reveal
raw dz2-resolved ARPES/XAS/RIXS or DFT-constrained spectral weight for the same samples
normal-state optical/NMR linewidths measured at the frozen temperatures
sample-resolved oxygen vacancy and structural linewidth metrics with output labels withheld
hard_prohibitions: No Tc, zero resistance, shielding, Meissner fraction, critical current, Josephson plasma, superfluid density, condensate spectral weight, bulk phase stiffness, or transition-width fit may enter E_z2, C_phi, Gamma_phi, E_floor, thresholds, windows, sample exclusion, or coefficients.
No pressure point, temperature point, spectral window, or missing-data rule may be changed after any bulk superconducting output is opened.
Density-wave disappearance may be logged as context but is not sufficient evidence for superconductivity and is not an input to I_phi.

frozen_measurement_grid.sample_family: La3Ni2O7-delta or bilayer RP nickelate film/bulk samples; all samples declared before output reveal
frozen_measurement_grid.temperature_rule: I_phi is evaluated only at 120 K. Higher-temperature points are quality-control anchors for optical fits and structural continuity. If 120 K is unavailable because the normal-state spectrum cannot be obtained under the frozen protocol, the sample is marked not_computable rather than substituted by a post hoc temperature.
frozen_measurement_grid.output_blinding: Input files, fit scripts, coefficients, and sample inclusion list are timestamped before opening any bulk-output file. Output files are stored in a separate sealed directory until I_phi_sample_table is frozen.

E_z2.definition: input-side dz2 channel energy proxy from normalized dz2 spectral weight in the fixed window around EF
E_z2.primary_measurement: ARPES orbital projection if available; fallback to polarization-resolved XAS/RIXS or DFT-constrained spectral proxy declared before output reveal

units.S_z2_norm: dimensionless, normalized integral of dz2 spectral weight over -0.25 eV to +0.15 eV relative to EF
units.alpha_z2_meV: meV per unit normalized dz2 spectral weight

E_z2.coefficient_provenance: Protocol calibration constant chosen before output reveal to convert a unit-normalized orbital spectral weight into a 0-120 meV energy-scale proxy; not fitted to superconducting output. Literature provenance: nickelate dz2/apical oxygen and orbital-weight relevance from Sui et al. Phys Rev B 109, 205156 (2024), Lu et al. Commun Phys 8 (2025), and bilayer nickelate electronic-structure papers already logged in Round 1.
quality_controls: Use identical orbital-projection basis for every sample.
Background subtraction is fixed from the 5000-8000 cm^-1 optical or high-binding-energy spectroscopy window as applicable.
If S_z2_norm is outside [0, 1.2], flag fit_failure and do not compute I_phi.

C_phi.definition: dimensionless input-side recoverable interlayer phase-bus observability factor from normal-state c-axis optical conductivity only
C_phi.least_circular_route: Fit the 120 K c-axis optical conductivity with a frozen normal-state transfer-matrix model containing one narrow Drude component, one broad incoherent component, and fixed interband/background terms. C_phi is the narrow coherent spectral-weight fraction after enforcing passivity and nonnegative weights.
C_phi.formula: C_phi = max(0, min(1, W_c_Drude/(W_c_Drude + W_c_incoh + epsilon_W)))

units.W_c_Drude: ohm^-1 cm^-2, numerical integral of fitted narrow Drude sigma1_c over 0-600 cm^-1
units.W_c_incoh: ohm^-1 cm^-2, numerical integral of fitted broad incoherent sigma1_c over 600-5000 cm^-1 after fixed background subtraction

inputs: sample thickness or pressure-cell optical path declared before fitting
c-axis reflectivity/transmission or ellipsometry spectrum at 120 K
fixed substrate/diamond/anvil optical constants from calibration run
same pressure point metadata before output reveal
model_components: narrow normal-state Drude oscillator in 0-600 cm^-1
broad incoherent oscillator constrained by 600-5000 cm^-1 area
no superconducting delta function, no Josephson plasma oscillator, no condensate term
pass_fail_rules: PASS if both W_c_Drude and W_c_incoh are nonnegative and the low-frequency Kramers-Kronig/transfer-matrix residual is within the preregistered instrument tolerance.
FAIL if a superconducting, Josephson, condensate, or phase-stiffness component is required to fit the spectrum.
FAIL if the fit requires changing the 0-600 cm^-1 or 600-5000 cm^-1 windows after inspecting output labels.
FAIL if pressure/temperature points are dropped because of known superconducting behavior rather than documented optical data failure.

C_phi.coefficient_provenance: Optical spectral-weight and Drude/scattering decomposition are established in layered conductors; MCP searches found c-axis optical spectra in La2-xSrxCuO4 (Uchida et al., Phys Rev B 53, 14558, 1996) and recent anisotropic optical spectroscopy in La4Ni3O10 (Liu et al., arXiv:2512.03806). These are method provenance only, not validation for I_phi.

Gamma_phi.definition: input-side dephasing/scattering rate in the same normal-state stack

units.Gamma_Drude_cm_minus_1: cm^-1, narrow Drude scattering width from normal-state c-axis optical fit

Gamma_phi.fallback_measurement: normal-state NMR 1/T1 or linewidth converted to ps^-1 only if the conversion rule is declared before output reveal; no superconducting fluctuation or transition broadening fits
Gamma_phi.coefficient_provenance: Direct unit conversion using 1 cm^-1 = 0.188365 ps^-1; normal-state NMR and DW context from Kakoi et al., J Phys Soc Jpn 93, 053702 (2024), used only as measurability provenance.

E_floor.definition: nonnegative disorder/structure energy floor preventing divergence and penalizing oxygen/strain/residual-scattering damage

units.sigma_vac_pct: percentage points of apical oxygen vacancy/disorder proxy, e.g. 1.5 means 1.5 percent
units.sigma_strain_mrad: mrad excess rocking-curve or structural-linewidth metric above instrument baseline
units.Gamma_res_ps_inv: ps^-1 residual normal-state scattering rate at 300 K or pressure-cell baseline

E_floor.coefficient_provenance: Fixed conservative coefficients chosen before output reveal to make oxygen vacancy, strain/stacking disorder, and residual scattering visible at meV scale. Literature provenance for relevance, not coefficient fitting: Lu et al. Commun Phys 8 (2025) on pressure/apical oxygen vacancies; Sui et al. Phys Rev B 109, 205156 (2024) on oxygen vacancies and dz2 electronic structure; Wang et al. Inorg Chem 63 (2024) and ACS structural supplements on hidden/temperature-dependent structure.

main_equation.label: I_phi_round2_preregistered
divergence_controls: T_K is fixed to 120 K, so kB*T = 10.3407999144 meV.
E_floor_meV is bounded below by 3 meV.
If denominator is not finite or is below 13.3407999144 meV, mark formula_error; do not rescale after output reveal.

limits.desc: no recoverable normal-state c-axis coherent channel
finite because T_K and E_floor_min_meV are fixed nonzero
strong disorder/structure floor suppresses the index

missing_data_rules.sample_set_freeze: The sample list and pressure-temperature grid are frozen before output reveal.
missing_data_rules.not_computable_rule: If any required primary input is missing or fails QC, I_phi_status is not_computable. The sample remains in the preregistration ledger and cannot be silently excluded.
missing_data_rules.sensitivity_rule: A separate worst-case sensitivity table may assign C_phi=0 for missing C_phi or E_z2=0 for missing E_z2, but this table is labeled sensitivity_only and cannot replace the primary ledger.
missing_data_rules.outlier_rule: Input outliers are winsorized only at preregistered physical bounds: S_z2_norm in [0, 1.2], C_phi in [0, 1], E_z2_meV <= 120. No output-aware outlier deletion.
missing_data_rules.pressure_failure_rule: If pressure calibration fails, the pressure point is marked pressure_QC_fail with the calibration log. It is not moved to a neighboring pressure after output reveal.
missing_data_rules.fit_failure_rule: If optical transfer-matrix residual exceeds the frozen tolerance or requires forbidden superconducting components, C_phi_status is fit_failure and I_phi is not computed.

coefficient_provenance_summary.alpha_z2_meV: predeclared scale for normalized orbital spectral weight; literature-motivated by dz2 relevance but numerically fixed by protocol convention
coefficient_provenance_summary.epsilon_W_ohm_inv_cm_minus_2: instrument-stabilizer area comparable to a small optical spectral-weight noise floor; fixed before output reveal
coefficient_provenance_summary.lambda_vac_meV_per_pct: predeclared disorder penalty per percentage point apical oxygen vacancy proxy; relevance from oxygen-vacancy nickelate literature
coefficient_provenance_summary.lambda_strain_meV_per_mrad: predeclared structural-linewidth penalty; relevance from hidden/temperature-dependent structural nickelate literature
coefficient_provenance_summary.lambda_res: predeclared residual-scattering penalty converting hbarGamma_res into a floor contribution
coefficient_provenance_summary.threshold_policy: No superconducting-output threshold is set in Round 2. If PI later sets a go/no-go I_phi threshold, it must be fixed before output reveal or trained only on an external dataset that is not part of the evaluation set.

baseline_collapse_checks.purpose: After output reveal only, test whether I_phi adds anything beyond simpler input-side explanations. These checks evaluate collapse risk; they do not validate the index in Round 2.

predeclared_baselines.interpretation: generic c-axis optical spectral weight without coherent-fraction distinction

collapse_failures: If C_phi-only ranks samples as well as I_phi within the preregistered uncertainty, I_phi collapses to generic interlayer coherence.
If disorder-only ranks samples as well as I_phi, I_phi collapses to sample-quality or oxygen/strain control.
If E_z2-only ranks samples as well as I_phi, the denominator and C_phi are unnecessary.
If total c-axis weight ranks samples as well as I_phi, the coherent/incoherent split is not justified.
baseline_collapse_checks.evaluation_metric_after_reveal: Use the same predeclared metric for I_phi and baselines, e.g. rank correlation or AUROC against withheld output. Do not choose the metric after seeing which model wins.

three_sample_mock_calculation.status: mock arithmetic only; not real data; no validation

claims.statement: A dimensionally consistent I_phi encoder is lab-feasible only if E_z2, C_phi, Gamma_phi, and E_floor are computed in meV/meV-compatible units from frozen input-side measurements.

variables.E_z2_meV: input-side dz2 spectral-weight energy proxy in meV

assumptions: The input measurements are performed and frozen before output reveal.
The coefficients are not trained on bulk superconducting output.

claims.statement: The least-circular C_phi is a normal-state c-axis optical coherent-fraction audit, not any superconducting phase-stiffness or condensate observable.

variables.W_c_Drude: 0-600 cm^-1 fitted normal-state narrow Drude spectral weight, ohm^-1 cm^-2
variables.W_c_incoh: 600-5000 cm^-1 fitted normal-state incoherent spectral weight, ohm^-1 cm^-2

references.label: Liu et al. 2025 La4Ni3O10 optical spectroscopy

assumptions: Normal-state c-axis optical spectra have sufficient SNR under pressure or in film geometry.
The fitting model excludes superconducting optical components.

claims.statement: Divergence is controlled by frozen T=120 K, E_floor>=3 meV, C_phi clipping, and E_z2 capping; therefore low-Gamma or low-disorder samples cannot create an infinite index.

variables.sigma_vac_pct: apical oxygen vacancy/disorder proxy in percentage points

references.label: Wang et al. 2024 hidden structural phase

assumptions: The floor coefficients are protocol constants rather than output-fitted weights.
The structural and oxygen metrics are measured input-side.

deepening_1.next_consequence: If C_phi can be measured this way, false positives become diagnostic: a sample may have input-side c-axis phase-bus readiness but still fail bulk superconductivity because pairing amplitude, percolation, phase purity, or disorder bottlenecks are missing.
deepening_1.second_consequence: Therefore evaluation must not optimize I_phi to eliminate false positives; it must compare I_phi against baselines and preserve failures as evidence about mechanism separation.

deepening_2.most_fragile_assumption: That a normal-state c-axis Drude fraction is an input-side observability proxy rather than an already sufficient generic interlayer-coherence label.
deepening_2.second_consequence: If C_phi-only or total c-axis spectral weight performs as well as I_phi after output reveal, LP28-S1 collapses to prior-art interlayer coherence and should not be claimed as an independent index.

inspector_check.formula: I_phi = E_z2_meV*C_phi/(kB_meV_per_K*T_K + hbarGamma_phi_meV + E_floor_meV), dimensionless; C_phi = W_c_Drude/(W_c_Drude + W_c_incoh + epsilon_W)
inspector_check.direction: Increasing E_z2 or C_phi increases I_phi; increasing Gamma_phi, T, or E_floor decreases I_phi; divergence is bounded by T=120 K and E_floor>=3 meV.
inspector_check.data: Mock arithmetic plus literature-provenance stack only; no validation and no bulk output used.
inspector_check.assumptions: Normal-state optical decomposition is feasible with frozen windows; all coefficients and missing-data rules are timestamped before output reveal.
